description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper class and related factory functions for GStreamer utility operations within the Rialto server namespace. It includes functions for creating wrapper instances and performing audio track codec channel switching.

classes.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory
classes.description: Interface for factory creating RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper instances.

classes.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class implementing creation of RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper objects.

classes.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class providing GStreamer utility functions, including performing audio track codec channel switching.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the factory for creating RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper objects.

methods.name: performAudioTrackCodecChannelSwitch
methods.description: Performs a switch of the audio track codec channel, given various parameters related to playback and audio attributes.
